subject.title: fix(secrets): keep unaffected owners live during reload failures

question: Should OpenClaw adopt owner-scoped stale credential retention during SecretRef reloads as the compatibility contract for existing providers, auth profiles, and plugin owners?
rationale: The patch changes runtime credential availability after a secret-provider outage; this is a product and upgrade contract that tests alone cannot choose, and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve the owner-scoped contract
options.body: Accept stale retention only for unchanged owner contracts after a maintainer reviews the live proof and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep reload fail-closed
options.body: Reject stale retention and preserve the prior all-or-nothing reload behavior if avoiding use of last-known-good credentials is preferred.

options.title: Narrow the supported owners
options.body: Permit the behavior only for explicitly selected owner classes and defer other provider or plugin paths.

recommendation.title: Approve the owner-scoped contract
recommendation.body: Accept stale retention only for unchanged owner contracts after a maintainer reviews the live proof and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged operator-state work and the current branch place this person closest to the intended reload contract.
